title: Bacon Fried Broccoli Rice
description: A nice alternative to the traditional fried rice side dish, this tasty, low-carb version features frozen broccoli rice fried in bacon grease and served with crispy, crumbled bacon.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons green onion, chopped (green part only)

steps.text: Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon to a paper towel-lined plate, and leave 2 tablespoons bacon grease in the skillet. Crumble bacon when cool enough to touch.

Add onions to the skillet and cook over medium-high heat until soft and translucent, 3 to 4 minutes. Add broccoli rice and fry until tender, stirring frequently, about 5 minutes. Mix in beaten eggs and stir until well combined. Cook until eggs are completely scrambled into broccoli rice mixture. Turn off heat and stir in soy sauce.
Add crumbled bacon just before serving and stir to incorporate. Top with green onions.
